lines.text: Music: hold the cover for Up next and History; queued songs keep your order, with Undo.
Music uses far less data: a 20 s buffer, songs you played are kept, one cover per album.
The side rail follows the sort (letters, years or months), and the player's cover shows at once.
Playlists: name a new one, rename by its title, undo removals; sorting only changes the view.
